name: KEDA Scaling Deployments documentation
notes: KEDA (Kubernetes Event-Driven Autoscaling) supports 70+ scalers including Prometheus, CPU, Memory, and external metrics. Can scale to zero. Handles long-running executions via lifecycle hooks. KServe v0.21.0 added direct KEDA scaling support with idleReplicaCount=0 for true scale-to-zero.
